(1 of 3) WORK ANNOUNCEMENT: Court operations in some areas are SUSPENDED on November 17 and 18, 2025, in view of the expected traffic congestion within the vicinity of the courts and surrounding areas which may be brought about by the staging of the three-day rally of the Iglesia Ni Cristo. 

- Supreme Court: WORK-FROM-HOME; skeleton workforce to be maintained at the Docket-Receiving Section of the Judicial Records Office and Cash Collection and Disbursement Division of the Fiscal Management and Budget Office

- Court of Appeals Manila Station, except Security personnel on-duty: WORK-FROM-HOME; skeleton workforce to be maintained at the One-Stop Processing Center, Finance Offices, General Services Division, and Medical Division

- Sandiganbayan: WORK-FROM HOME; skeleton workforce to be maintained at the Office of the Executive Clerk of Court IV, Judicial Records Division, Security and Sheriff Services Division, and Cashier Section

- Court of Tax Appeals: WORK-FROM-HOME; skeleton workforce to be maintained at the Offices of the Division Clerks of Court, Docketing-Receiving Section, Judicial Records Division, and Cash Division

- All courts in Manila: WORK-FROM-HOME; skeleton workforce to be maintained to act on urgent matters

#SupremeCourtPH #SCphWalangPasok

data.text:
'GAME OF THE GENERALS'

WATCH │Former AFP chief, Retired General Hermogenes Esperon Jr. and Former PCG Commandant Damian Carlos also attended the "Rally para sa pananagutan, katapatan at katarungan" in People Power Monument, along EDSA White Plains, Quezon City on Sunday.

Esperon, who was the former National Security Adviser of former President Rodrigo Duterte and former AFP chief of Former President Gloria Arroyo said that changes must be made and that corrupt officials must resign from their current post.

He also said that the Philippine Government must undergo a Constitutional Change by having a Constitutional Convention.

Carlos also supported the statement of Esperon for change.

They were with other PDP-LABAN officials led by former Energy Secretary Alfonso Cusi, Jimmy Bondoc, Mike Defensor and other retired Generals. 

🎥│📝: Vince Lopez
